annotations.title: Base Token Facts: Owner, Proxy, Pause and Mint Powers

description: Verifiable on-chain facts about an ERC-20 token on Base: name, symbol, supply, whether the contract has an owner (and whether it was renounced), whether it is an upgradeable proxy and who administers it, whether it is paused, and which privileged functions (mint, burn, pause, blacklist, fee setting, upgrade) appear in its bytecode. Facts only: no verdict and no recommendation. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).
